description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useMe' that fetches the current user data from a backend API using Supabase authentication. It manages state for user data, loading status, and errors, and provides functions to refetch user info and ping a protected API endpoint.

methods.name: useMe
methods.description: React hook that fetches and manages current user data, loading state, error state, and provides utility functions for refetching and pinging protected API.
